conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm air and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

Per the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Standard is $189 per year or $16.99 per month, with a 12-month minimum on monthly billing.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year and adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Standard and Plus members also get $500 off any full system replacement.

The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership, and I can't say whether joining would save you money on this repair.
